detail.body:
## Description

Add a sequential Geometry3K training smoke test to the existing eight-NPU Ascend PR job. Qwen3.5-0.8B runs two GRPO updates with Megatron and vLLM both using d1p2t2, followed by evaluation on one example and an HF checkpoint save. The test requires normal trainer shutdown, two completed steps, one completed evaluation, and readable checkpoint weights.

Use one prompt with four completions per update, 16–32 generated tokens, FULL_DECODE_ONLY graph decoding, and MTP with three speculative tokens. Reuse the cached model and Geometry3K dataset, download the dataset when missing, preserve the runner's HCCL interface setting, and upload controller/worker logs plus completion evidence. Existing Qwen3.5 tests remain enabled.

## Related Issue

No linked issue.

## Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix
- [ ] ✨ New feature
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] ♻️ Refactoring
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement
- [x] ✅ Test coverage improvement

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read the [Contributing Guide](https://github.com/areal-project/community/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] Pre-commit hooks pass (`pre-commit run --all-files`)
- [x] Relevant tests pass; new tests added for new functionality
- [ ] Documentation updated (if applicable; built with `./docs/build_all.sh`)
- [ ] Branch is up to date with `main`
- [ ] Self-reviewed via `/review-pr` command
- [x] This PR was created by a coding agent via `/create-pr`
- [ ] This PR is a breaking change

**Breaking Change Details (if applicable):** None.

## Additional Context

Targets `ascend`. Full pre-commit, structured GRPO config loading, workflow shell syntax, Python syntax, and `git diff --check` passed locally. [Full Ascend CI](https://github.com/areal-project/AReaL/actions/runs/39166069674) passed on `6d23bb524`: CPU tests, existing NPU suites, and the new E2E test are all green. The E2E test passed in 483.40 seconds (8m03s), verifying two completed updates, one evaluation, normal trainer shutdown, and a checkpoint containing 488 tensors, with graph decoding and MTP enabled. The full NPU job took 23m08s.

The small dataset subsets load locally (`scheduling_spec: null`) so their lengths are available before trainer initialization. The harness prints controller-log tails on failure, emits stack traces after ten minutes, and bounds the training subprocess to fifteen minutes. Checkpoint files are validated then removed; logs and completion evidence are retained as CI artifacts. Existing tests are enabled, and temporary production diagnostics have been removed.

Two earlier probes stalled during setup after weight-group creation; the cause remains unconfirmed. Both the subsequent diagnostic run and the cleaned-up full-suite run passed. This establishes successful end-to-end execution, not numerical convergence or long-run stability.

The logging/cleanup follow-up prints the full controller log in a grouped CI step on success and failure, handles SIGTERM through the harness cleanup, and removes the run-specific temporary directory in an always-run CI cleanup step. Model and dataset caches remain reusable. Local subprocess checks cover success, failure, and SIGTERM; a shell check covers interrupted-run log preservation and checkpoint removal. Full pre-commit passes. The full CI result above predates this follow-up.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+"""Run the real two-step Geometry3K trainer and record completion evidence."""
+
+import faulthandler
+import json
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+from safetensors import safe_open
+
+from areal import PPOTrainer
+from areal.api.cli_args import GRPOConfig, load_expr_config
+from areal.dataset import get_custom_dataset
+from areal.utils.hf_utils import load_hf_processor_and_tokenizer
+from areal.utils.saver import Saver
+
+
+def main(args: list[str]) -> None:
+    faulthandler.dump_traceback_later(600, repeat=True)
+    config, _ = load_expr_config(args, GRPOConfig)
+    processor, tokenizer = load_hf_processor_and_tokenizer(config.tokenizer_path)
+    train_dataset = get_custom_dataset(
+        split="train[:2]",
+        dataset_config=config.train_dataset,
+        tokenizer=tokenizer,
+        processor=processor,
+    )
+    valid_dataset = get_custom_dataset(
+        split="test[:1]",
+        dataset_config=config.valid_dataset,
+        tokenizer=tokenizer,
+        processor=processor,
+    )
+    assert len(train_dataset) == 2
+    assert len(valid_dataset) == 1
+    workflow_kwargs = dict(
+        reward_fn="examples.vlm.geometry3k_grpo.geometry3k_reward_fn",
+        gconfig=config.gconfig,
+        tokenizer=config.tokenizer_path,
+        processor=config.tokenizer_path,
+        enable_thinking=False,
+    )
+    eval_kwargs = {**workflow_kwargs, "gconfig": config.eval_gconfig}
+    with PPOTrainer(
+        config, train_dataset=train_dataset, valid_dataset=valid_dataset
+    ) as trainer:
+        # These spies call through to the real implementations.
+        with (
+            patch.object(
+                trainer.stats_logger, "commit", wraps=trainer.stats_logger.commit
+            ) as commits,
+            patch.object(
+                trainer, "_evaluate_fn", wraps=trainer._evaluate_fn
+            ) as evaluations,
+        ):
+            trainer.train(
+                workflow="areal.workflow.vision_rlvr.VisionRLVRWorkflow",
+                workflow_kwargs=workflow_kwargs,
+                eval_workflow="areal.workflow.vision_rlvr.VisionRLVRWorkflow",
+                eval_workflow_kwargs=eval_kwargs,
+            )
+            steps = [call.args[2] for call in commits.call_args_list]
+            assert steps == [0, 1], steps
+            assert evaluations.call_count == 1, evaluations.call_count
+
+    checkpoint = Path(
+        Saver.get_model_save_path(
+            config.experiment_name,
+            config.trial_name,
+            config.cluster.fileroot,
+            epoch=0,
+            step=1,
+            globalstep=1,
+        )
+    )
+    assert (checkpoint / "config.json").is_file(), checkpoint
+    assert (checkpoint / "tokenizer_config.json").is_file(), checkpoint
+    weights = sorted(checkpoint.glob("*.safetensors"))
+    assert weights, checkpoint
+    keys = set()
+    for weight in weights:
+        with safe_open(weight, framework="pt", device="cpu") as handle:
+            shard_keys = list(handle.keys())
+            assert shard_keys, weight
+            keys.update(shard_keys)
+    index = checkpoint / "model.safetensors.index.json"
+    if index.exists():
+        weight_map = json.loads(index.read_text())["weight_map"]
+        assert set(weight_map).issubset(keys)
+        assert set(weight_map.values()).issubset({path.name for path in weights})
+    evidence = {
+        "completed_train_steps": len(steps),
+        "completed_evaluations": evaluations.call_count,
+        "evaluation_examples": len(valid_dataset),
+        "checkpoint": str(checkpoint),
+        "weight_files": [path.name for path in weights],
+        "saved_tensor_count": len(keys),
+    }
+    (Path(config.cluster.fileroot) / "completion.json").write_text(
+        json.dumps(evidence, indent=2) + "\n"
+    )
+    faulthandler.cancel_dump_traceback_later()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main(sys.argv[1:])

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+import json
+import os
+import shutil
+import signal
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import uuid
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import psutil
+import pytest
+
+pytestmark = [pytest.mark.multi_npu, pytest.mark.slow, pytest.mark.ci]
+
+
+def test_geometry3k_two_steps_evaluates_and_saves(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    """Exercise PP2/TP2 training, vLLM graph/MTP rollout, evaluation and HF save."""
+    torch = pytest.importorskip("torch")
+    pytest.importorskip("torch_npu")
+    if not torch.npu.is_available() or torch.npu.device_count() < 8:
+        pytest.skip("Requires eight Ascend NPUs")
+    model_path = os.environ.get("AREAL_TEST_QWEN35_PATH")
+    assert model_path and (Path(model_path) / "config.json").is_file(), (
+        "Set AREAL_TEST_QWEN35_PATH to a cached Qwen3.5-0.8B model"
+    )
+    output = Path(os.environ.get("AREAL_E2E_OUTPUT_DIR", str(tmp_path / "output")))
+    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    work_parent = os.environ.get("AREAL_E2E_WORK_DIR")
+    if work_parent:
+        Path(work_parent).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(
+        prefix="geometry3k-e2e-", dir=work_parent
+    ) as workdir:
+        root = Path(workdir)
+        cmd = [
+            sys.executable,
+            "-m",
+            "tests.run_ascend_training_e2e",
+            "--config",
+            "tests/configs/ascend_geometry3k_grpo.yaml",
+            f"actor.path={model_path}",
+            f"cluster.fileroot={root}",
+            f"cluster.name_resolve.nfs_record_root={root / 'name_resolve'}",
+            f"trial_name=ci-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}",
+        ]
+        with (output / "controller.log").open("w") as log:
+            process = subprocess.Popen(
+                cmd,
+                stdout=log,
+                stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
+                start_new_session=True,
+            )
+            # Let CI timeout/cancellation unwind the process and directory cleanup.
+            previous_sigterm = signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, signal.default_int_handler)
+            try:
+                returncode = process.wait(timeout=900)
+                assert returncode == 0, (
+                    f"Training exited with {returncode}; see {output / 'controller.log'}\n"
+                    + "".join(
+                        (output / "controller.log")
+                        .read_text()
+                        .splitlines(keepends=True)[-120:]
+                    )
+                )
+                evidence = json.loads((root / "completion.json").read_text())
+                assert evidence["completed_train_steps"] == 2
+                assert evidence["completed_evaluations"] == 1
+                shutil.copy2(root / "completion.json", output / "completion.json")
+            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+                pytest.fail(
+                    "Training timed out. Controller log tail:\n"
+                    + "".join(
+                        (output / "controller.log")
+                        .read_text()
+                        .splitlines(keepends=True)[-120:]
+                    )
+                )
+            finally:
+                signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, previous_sigterm)
+                if process.poll() is None:
+                    parent = psutil.Process(process.pid)
+                    children = parent.children(recursive=True)
+                    for child in reversed(children):
+                        try:
+                            child.kill()
+                        except psutil.NoSuchProcess:
+                            pass
+                    process.kill()
+                    process.wait(timeout=30)
+                    psutil.wait_procs(children, timeout=10)
+                if (root / "logs").exists():
+                    shutil.copytree(
+                        root / "logs", output / "workers", dirs_exist_ok=True
+                    )
+    assert not root.exists(), f"Temporary training files remain at {root}"
